global_rules.data_testid_requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format (e.g., data-testid='login-email-input').
global_rules.theme_support: MUST fully support both Dark and Light modes using Tailwind's standard dark: classes.

layout_strategy.composition: Immersive Floating Glass Bento Overlay. Not a rigid split-screen, but a centered dynamic container overlapping a high-fidelity abstract background.
layout_strategy.container: min-h-screen w-full flex items-center justify-center p-4 md:p-8 relative overflow-hidden
layout_strategy.background_treatment: Full-screen absolute positioning. Dark mode uses deep void black with subtle glowing mesh. Light mode uses frosty silver mesh. An additional heavy vignette/gradient mask prevents text collision.

grid_structure.wrapper: relative z-10 max-w-6xl w-full grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 items-center
grid_structure.marketing_bento_col: hidden lg:grid lg:col-span-6 xl:col-span-7 grid-cols-2 gap-4

surfaces.glass_card: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/5 dark:bg-white/5 bg-white/70 dark:border-white/10 border-black/10 border shadow-2xl rounded-3xl p-8 md:p-12
surfaces.bento_widget: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/5 dark:bg-white/5 bg-white/60 dark:border-white/10 border-black/5 border rounded-2xl p-6 hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform duration-300

inputs.style: Floating label approach. No clunky borders. 1px bottom border only that glows neon on focus.
inputs.classes: w-full bg-transparent border-b border-black/20 dark:border-white/20 px-0 py-3 text-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black dark:focus:border-[#CCFF00] transition-colors rounded-none
inputs.phone_input: flex gap-2. Country code dropdown styled as a minimal selector with border-r, next to the main phone number input.

buttons.primary: w-full py-4 rounded-xl font-bold tracking-wide transition-all duration-300 transform hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98] bg-black text-[#CCFF00] dark:bg-[#CCFF00] dark:text-black shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.2)] dark:hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(204,255,0,0.4)]
buttons.secondary_social: w-full py-4 rounded-xl font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-3 border border-black/10 dark:border-white/10 bg-white/50 dark:bg-black/50 hover:bg-white dark:hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors backdrop-blur-md

otp_input.slot: w-12 h-14 md:w-16 md:h-16 border border-black/20 dark:border-white/20 rounded-xl text-center text-2xl font-mono focus:border-black dark:focus:border-[#CCFF00] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-black dark:focus:ring-[#CCFF00] bg-white/50 dark:bg-black/50 transition-all

password_strength.checklist_item: flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-mono text-muted-foreground transition-colors. Checked state uses primary neon color.

shared_elements.header_controls: Absolute top-6 right-6 flex items-center gap-4 z-50
shared_elements.language_switcher: Minimal dropdown showing EN/PT/FR/ES/DE/NL with globe icon. Glassmorphism styling.
shared_elements.theme_toggle: Icon button toggling sun/moon, applies 'dark' class to html.
shared_elements.logo: Positioned top-8 left-8 absolute or embedded at top of auth form for mobile. SVG format.

login.flow: Two-step architecture via Framer Motion AnimatePresence.
login.step_1: Email/Phone toggle tabs. Input field. 'Continue' button. 'Continue with Google' divider.
login.step_2: Animates horizontally. Shows active email in a read-only pill with an 'Edit' pencil. Password field below. 'Sign In' button. 'Forgot Password?' link (triggers modal).
login.marketing_panel: Three bento widgets: 1. Big bold typography '1,000+ Businesses', 2. Scrolling marquee of 15+ Crypto Icons (BTC, ETH, SOL, etc.), 3. Highlight card '<1min Settlements' with a glowing green pulse dot.

register.flow: Collects Email/Phone -> Password creation -> OTP verification.
register.password_creation: Includes the real-time segmented neon strength bar + checklist.
register.otp_verification: Triggers OTP Dialog. Distinguishes UI message depending on Email or Phone selection.

forgot_password.flow: Triggered as a Glassmorphism Dialog over the login screen. Input email -> Send Reset Link -> Confirm State.

motion_interactions.page_load: Staggered fade-in. Background scale-down from 1.1 to 1.0 (duration: 1.5s, ease: 'easeOut'). Bento boxes animate in from bottom (y: 20, opacity: 0) with a stagger of 0.1s.
motion_interactions.two_step_transition: initial: { x: 20, opacity: 0 }, animate: { x: 0, opacity: 1 }, exit: { x: -20, opacity: 0 }, transition: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 300, damping: 30 }
motion_interactions.modals: Backdrop uses initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }}. Dialog uses initial={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }}.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Install 'framer-motion' for complex layout transitions (2-step login) and 'lucide-react' for icons.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Override default Shadcn input borders to match the '1px bottom border only' guideline using Tailwind classes.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Implement the layout as a Floating Bento overlay rather than a full-height split screen.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Ensure the Language Switcher and Dark Mode toggle are sticky or absolute-positioned outside the main scrollable form area.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do not hardcode 'Inter' or 'Roboto'. Set up Unbounded (heading), Manrope (body), and JetBrains Mono (mono) via Google Fonts or Next.js font optimization.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Add data-testid to every input, button, and dynamic component for E2E testing compatibility.
